decisions.decision: Scope the emulator to TMOS 17.5 only.
decisions.rationale: The user explicitly requested a single pinned version so behavior and catalog inputs remain reproducible.

decisions.decision: Use the pinned tcl-lsp checkout at cad24955f16953c2443902efd83d9f7f95d9b648 as the registry and Tcl execution framework.
decisions.rationale: This reuses the existing parser/runtime and makes the catalog source reproducible without modifying the external checkout.

decisions.decision: Keep adapter-owned behavioral semantics in tools/semantic-mocks.tcl and leave upstream tcl-lsp untouched.
decisions.rationale: The overlay can evolve independently while preserving upstream compatibility and making semantic ownership explicit in conformance output.

decisions.decision: Run all Python through the repo-local uv environment or the container uv virtual environment, with Python 3.13 or newer.
decisions.rationale: System Python execution caused local instability; the host .venv is Python 3.13.9 and the image runtime is Python 3.13.15.

decisions.decision: Treat generated command stubs as recognition coverage, not behavioral emulation.
decisions.rationale: The conformance report must distinguish 1,292 generated stubs and 55 missing handlers from the 91 semantic and 61 handwritten implementations.

decisions.decision: Keep the service loopback-bound by default, cap inputs, and do not expose arbitrary Tcl evaluation.
decisions.rationale: The emulator is intended to be safe and portable for testing rather than a remote code execution surface.

next_action: Resume by checking git status, then implement and test HTTP::redirect plus HTTP::has_responded in the semantic overlay and adapter. Use the repo .venv Python 3.13 environment for host checks and rebuild/run testcl-irule-emulator:17.5 for integration checks.
context_notes: The latest committed slice e068c7c added exact HTTP Content-Length framing, chunked bodies with trailers, partial-body buffering, no-body response handling for 1xx/204/304, and ordered coalesced-message emission. The worktree was clean when paused. The current container conformance snapshot reports 1,499 commands, 176 events, and 18 packet adapters. The project is materially functional but not a true vLab: 1,292 catalog commands remain generated stubs, 55 have no runtime handler, 158 events are not packet-adapted, and many protocol families still need semantic state. Do not claim broad completion. No fork or push has been performed.
